brief.businessGoal: Make daily English vocabulary learning fun and habit-forming for young children through a warm, nature-themed experience with an animal mascot companion, encouraging consistent practice via progress tracking and playful interactions.
mustHaveContent: course progress cards with visual completion indicators
daily tasks checklist with reward stars
pronunciation hint buttons with speaker icon
large answer buttons for quiz interactions
large rounded touch-friendly controls (min 56px tap targets)
brief.style: warm, cute, nature-themed with soft greens, warm yellows, cream backgrounds

techStack.backend: NestJS (production planning, not part of this design artifact)

output.previewStrategy: Generate Next.js + TypeScript project, start dev server with `next dev`, and connect to Canvas via add_frame with localhost URL.

artifacts.purpose: Root layout with Nunito font loading, global metadata, bottom tab navigation, and persistent mascot companion.
requirements: Next.js App Router root layout with <html> and <body>
Nunito font via next/font/google
Bottom tab navigation component (Home, Courses, Practice) with large rounded icons
Persistent fox mascot in corner that reacts to route context
Landscape tablet layout optimized for 1024x768+
Import globals.css

artifacts.purpose: Home dashboard showing daily tasks, course progress cards, streak counter, and mascot greeting.
requirements: Mascot greeting banner with speech bubble (e.g. 'Hi! Ready to learn today?')
Daily tasks section: 3 task cards with checkbox-style completion (listen, speak, write)
Course progress cards: horizontal scroll of 3-4 course cards with circular progress rings
Streak/reward display with star icons
Large touch targets, playful card shapes with soft shadows
Typed data models for tasks and courses

artifacts.purpose: Course detail page showing lesson list, overall progress, and a start/continue button.
requirements: Course header with illustration, title, and overall progress bar
Lesson list with lock/complete/current states (visual icons)
Word count and estimated time badges
Large 'Continue Learning' CTA button (pill-shaped, prominent)
Mascot encouragement tip at bottom
Typed lesson and course interfaces

artifacts.purpose: Interactive word practice quiz page with pronunciation hints, answer selection, and progress tracking.
requirements: Word progress bar at top (e.g. 3/10 words)
Word card with illustration, word text, and pronunciation speaker button
4 large answer buttons in 2x2 grid (pill/rounded-rect, color-coded)
Correct/incorrect feedback states with mascot reaction
Pronunciation hint: speaker icon button that highlights phonics
End-of-set celebration state with stars and mascot
Typed quiz state machine (idle, answering, feedback, complete)
Client component ('use client') for interactive quiz state

artifacts.purpose: Reusable fox mascot SVG component with multiple expression states (happy, thinking, celebrating, encouraging).
requirements: Inline SVG fox character with nature-themed accessories (leaf hat or acorn bag)
Expression variants: happy, thinking, celebrating, encouraging
Size variants: small (nav), medium (cards), large (greeting)
Gentle idle animation (subtle bounce via CSS keyframes)
TypeScript props interface with expression and size unions

artifacts.purpose: Bottom tab navigation bar with large child-friendly touch targets and active state indicators.
requirements: 3 tabs: Home, Courses, Practice with lucide-react icons
Minimum 64px height tap areas
Active tab highlighted with primary color pill background
Client component using next/navigation usePathname
Rounded top corners, soft shadow elevation

artifacts.purpose: Shared TypeScript type definitions for courses, lessons, words, tasks, and quiz state.
requirements: Course, Lesson, Word interfaces
DailyTask interface with completion state
QuizState type union
MascotExpression and MascotSize types

artifacts.purpose: Typed mock data for courses, lessons, words, and daily tasks (child-appropriate English learning content).
requirements: 3-4 courses with progress data
Lesson lists per course with states
10 vocabulary words with illustration descriptions and phonics
3 daily tasks
All content appropriate for 5-10 year old English learners

designDirection.colorPalette: Warm cream backgrounds (#FDF8EF), leaf green primary (#4CAF50 / #6FBA2C), sunny yellow accent (#FFCC00), soft coral for alerts (#F8A6B2), warm brown text (#725D42)
designDirection.typography: Nunito (rounded sans-serif) for all text; large sizes (body 18px+, headings 28-36px)
designDirection.mascot: Friendly fox character with leaf/nature accessories, multiple expressions
designDirection.controlStyle: Pill-shaped and large rounded-rect buttons, minimum 56px height, soft shadows, tactile press states

structure.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 3 tabs (Home, Courses, Practice), large icons with labels, persistent across routes via layout.tsx

interaction.primaryFlow: Home (/) -> tap course card -> Course Detail (/course) -> tap Continue -> Word Practice (/practice) -> complete quiz -> celebration -> back to Home with updated progress
states: Daily task: incomplete / complete (with star animation)
Answer button: default / selected / correct (green pulse) / incorrect (gentle shake)
Word practice: in-progress / correct feedback / incorrect feedback / set complete celebration

acceptanceCriteria: All interactive controls meet minimum 56px touch target size for children's fingers.
Color contrast meets WCAG AA for text on all backgrounds.
Mascot SVG renders correctly in all expression states.
Navigation between 3 routes works without errors via Next.js App Router.
Word practice quiz flow completes with correct/incorrect feedback and celebration.
TypeScript compiles with strict mode and no type errors.
Design quality check has P0=0 and all P1 issues are fixed or explicitly waived.
Next.js project builds successfully with npm run build (next build).
No placeholder lorem ipsum; all copy is child-appropriate English learning content.

risks: SVG mascot complexity: keep fox character simple enough to render performantly but expressive enough to feel alive.
shadcn/ui components need child-friendly overrides (larger radius, bigger tap areas) — plan custom CSS layer.
Tablet landscape layout must not feel like a stretched phone; use grid layouts that leverage wide viewport.
Next.js App Router: interactive quiz components need 'use client' directive; keep server components for static content.

abstract: 为 5-10 岁儿童设计一套高保真英语学习 App 的平板端界面（横屏），包含首页（/）、课程详情（/course）和单词练习（/practice）三个核心页面。整体采用温暖可爱的自然系风格：奶油色背景、树叶绿主色、阳光黄点缀，搭配一只友好的小狐狸吉祥物陪伴学习。界面使用大尺寸圆润控件（最小 56px 触控区域）、Nunito 圆体字体和柔和阴影，确保适合儿童手指操作。技术输出为 Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS，后端 NestJS 作为生产部署规划。请重点审核：三个页面的内容结构是否符合儿童学习场景、视觉风格是否足够温暖可爱、以及交互流程是否流畅自然。
